mission: Leia and Han learn of Centerpoint's disabling; Leia begins her private pivot away from Alliance service.
why_now: The news has just hit the Falcon's comm.
opening_hook: Leia at the Falcon's comm station with the Centerpoint news on-screen.
conflict: Leia's institutional role vs. her growing conviction that the Alliance has just made the war permanent.
turning_point: Leia decides, without telling Han yet, that she will step back from formal Alliance roles.
closing_hook: Leia closing the news channel; Han watching from the galley hatch.
sensory_details: Comm panel glow; Falcon's off-watch hum; Han's silhouette in the hatchway.
emotional_trajectory: News absorbed → private pivot → silent alignment with Han.
notes: Leia's pivot is interior here; it will enact at Ch 22.
